evidence.quote: It operates only while its power cable is connected to household mains.
Powered only by its mains cord; no battery or hand-operated mode.
It operates only from its attached AC mains lead.

parsed.reason: The intent hides desk tools that need a wall socket to work. A wall socket supplies household mains power. Items 71001, 71003 and 71006 operate only from a mains cable, so they match. Items 71002 and 71007 are hand-operated, and item 71004 uses batteries, so they do not match. Items 71005 and 71008 do not state a power source, so the evidence does not support them. The operation is exclude with strength none, which is a hard exclusion of the selected items.
